builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Gwen: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (4,721 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 59.6% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A melee AP duelist who stacks attacks into Q, seeks its center line, and uses mist to isolate threats. Sustained contact feeds percent-health damage and healing. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Dusk and Dawn → Shadowflame → Rabadon's Deathcap. Conqueror keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Void Staff, Riftmaker.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Dusk and Dawn → Shadowflame → Rabadon's Deathcap, with Conqueror.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Dusk and Dawn → Shadowflame → Rabadon's Deathcap) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 59.6% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Dusk and Dawn → Shadowflame → Rabadon's Deathcap.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Gwen gains 1 stack when she hits an enemy with an attack (max 4, lasts [6] seconds).

Active: Consumes stacks. Gwen snips once for [10 / 14 / 18 / 22 / 26 + (0.05) × AP] magic damage, snips again for each ammo consumed, and then snips a final time for [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage. 

The center of each strikes converts [50]% of the damage into true damage instead and applies A Thousand Cuts to enemies hit.

Deals [80]% damage to minions.
Minions below [20]% health take [1000]% bonus damage instead of reduced damage.

Gwen summons the Hallowed Mist, making her Untargetable to all enemies (except towers) outside the zone for [4] seconds or until she leaves it. While in the Mist, Gwen gains [22 / 24 / 26 / 28 / 30 + (0.07) × AP] Armor and Magic Resist.

Gwen can Recast this Ability once to call the Mist to her. This will automatically Recast the first time Gwen attempts to leave the zone.

Gwen dashes and empowers her Attacks for [4] seconds.

Empowered Attacks gain [(30 / 42.5 / 55 / 67.5 / 80) × (0.01)] Attack Speed, [15 + (0.2) × AP] magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit, [75] range, and the first one to hit an enemy refunds [(0.25 / 0.35 / 0.45 / 0.55 / 0.65) × 100]% of this Ability's Cooldown.

First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals [30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP] magic damage, Slows by [(-0.4 / -0.5 / -0.6) × -100]% for [1.5] seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds ([1]s cooldown between casts).

Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP) × (3)] magic damage
Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal [(30 / 50 / 70 + (0.1) × AP) × (5)] magic damage

Gwen's Attacks deal an additional [(1 + (0.006) × AP) × (0.01)] Max Health magic damage on hit. Gwen recovers Health equal to [0.67] of the damage this Ability deals to champions, up to a maximum of [characterLevelInterpolation(12 → 40; raw flags preserved) + (0.07) × AP].

builds.name: Mixed on-hit scissors
builds.summary: Test mixed on-hit scissors against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test mixed on-hit scissors against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Skip 'n Slash adds 0.2 AP magic on-hit plus attack speed and range; four ordinary attacks prepare Snip Snip. Nashor and Rageblade emphasize repeated attacks while Blade adds physical current-health damage, making Terminus's mixed penetration relevant to attacks even though Q centers deal true damage.
testPlan: Required state: Remain inside Hallowed Mist and build Q stacks before snipping.
Compare on-hit packets and Q center damage separately.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: No bulk or burst leaves Gwen vulnerable when Mist expires.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Rageblade is not assumed to multiply Q snips or grant extra Q stacks per phantom hit.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Blade of The Ruined King, Riftmaker, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: AP health frontline
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Gwen: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A melee AP duelist who stacks attacks into Q, seeks its center line, and uses mist to isolate threats. Sustained contact feeds percent-health damage and healing. Compare Q center hits, passive percent-health damage and attacks between casts. Mist positioning and the number of needle hits must be explicit; phantom hits need mechanic verification. Health/AP may sustain close spell pressure and debuff targets for allied magic damage.
builds.summary: Health/AP may sustain close spell pressure and debuff targets for allied magic damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Gwen: Compare Q center hits, passive percent-health damage and attacks between casts. Mist positioning and the number of needle hits must be explicit; phantom hits need mechanic verification.

Start with the early core (Riftmaker or Liandry, then the other) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Health/AP may sustain close spell pressure and debuff targets for allied magic damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Gwen snips her scissors in a cone up to 6 times dealing magic damage. Gwen deals true damage to units in the center and applies her passive to them on each snip. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Visage improves healing/shields received by its owner, not every ally shield; no free healing is assumed.

The route fails Gwen's stated kit question: Compare Q center hits, passive percent-health damage and attacks between casts. Mist positioning and the number of needle hits must be explicit; phantom hits need mechanic verification.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Visage improves healing/shields received by its owner, not every ally shield; no free healing is assumed.
Full cost 15,550 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Riftmaker or Liandry, then the other. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rylai's Crystal Scepter, Bloodletter's Curse, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Mist resistance drain
builds.summary: Test mist resistance drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test mist resistance drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: A Thousand Cuts heals from its champion damage, while Hallowed Mist grants 0.07 AP armor/MR; Riftmaker and Visage support repeated passive applications from Q centers and Needlework. Bloodletter assists magic passive/R packets, while Liandry supplies a burn during the extended duel.
testPlan: Required state: Hit Q centers and stay protected from enemies outside Mist.
Record passive healing through a complete nine-needle R sequence.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Enemies enter Mist or disengage before sustained effects mature.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Magic resistance reduction cannot amplify the true portion of centered Q.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
